crossRefs.note: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh…
Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.
He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it…
Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).
But the miry places of it, and its marshes, will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

translations.web: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
translations.bsb: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
translations.kjv: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell
translations.asv: A fruitful land into a salt desert, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
